source.note: Generated from the workbook. Wording is as in the IDD; whitespace was trimmed.

conventions.mandatory: true where the IDD level column holds '1' (mandatory), false where it holds 'O' (optional)
conventions.cardinality: min/max occurrences of a group; max null means unbounded ('*'); raw keeps the IDD text
conventions.level: IDD nesting level L1-L9; a group at level n contains items and groups at level n+1
conventions.dataType: parsed from the IDD 'data type' column; dataTypeRaw keeps the original text
conventions.validSet: name of an entry in validSets; validSetLinkedBy says how it was linked when the IDD Valid Set column is blank
conventions.itemCatalogue: matching entry in the IDD 'Items' sheet (by item name), where one exists; typeDiffers flags a different type there
conventions.implementation: SF Object, SF Field, Data Type, Conditions and API Dev Comment columns of the IDD
